attchmntText: Press Release - Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
sm_name: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute Limited
voiceSummary: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute Limited filed a press release regarding its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 11, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, Revenue from Operations was Rs. 17.72 crore, showing 36% growth. Net Profit was Rs. 43.95 lakh, compared to Rs. 11.58 lakh in the previous year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, Revenue from Operations was Rs. 34.78 crore, a 31% increase. Net Profit rose 59% to Rs. 1.05 crore. Profit Before Tax for the half year was Rs. 1.57 crore. The Statutory Auditors conducted a limited review of the results.

attchmntText: LOTUSEYE: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute Limited
voiceSummary: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute Limited announced the approval of its Standalone Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 11, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report from statutory auditors Anbarasu and Jalapathi. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of 105.32 lakhs, compared to a net loss of 8.04 lakhs for the year ended March 31, 2026. Revenue from operations stood at 3478.12 lakhs for the half year. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 10,059.04 lakhs. The company operates in a single segment related to eye care services and has no subsidiaries or joint ventures.
